quotes.text: Build an integration where you render the Mobile Payment Element before you create a PaymentIntent or SetupIntent, then confirm the Intent from your server.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: Build an integration where you render the Mobile Payment Element before you create a PaymentIntent or SetupIntent, then confirm the Intent from your server.
A SetupIntent flow allows you to collect payment method details and save them for future payments without creating a charge.
Your server creates and confirms a PaymentIntent and returns its client secret.
Your server creates and confirms a SetupIntent and returns its client secret.
For example, although OXXO isn’t supported by PaymentSheet

findings: raw/stripe-payments-mobile-finalize-payments-on-the-server-2026-11-07.md:5-21 retains the integration title and order at raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:4-6 and replaces the six complete platform/purpose variants (old raw lines 8-6106) with six Markdown variant links. Both Intent branches are named, and the November capture independently establishes the sequence and server role. It adds no confirmed integration or API behavior. The variant targets were not followed.

The old snapshot's header records 2026-04-22 at raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:1-4 despite the filename suffix. The new snapshot is 2026-11-07 at raw/stripe-payments-mobile-finalize-payments-on-the-server-2026-11-07.md:1-3. The full raw/diff were read in contiguous dual-numbered ranges. The collector diff joins the final old line and the first new index entry onto tracking/collections/stripe/recollection-2026-11-07-en/pages/b9ffc39d929509293e723526/content.diff:6107, and the two pinned raws show the two fragments separately. This is a serialization artifact.

wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md:13-38 correctly preserves the April PaymentIntent handoff and matching configuration, but an answer to which Intent is created to set up a payment method would be wrong or incomplete because the source calls itself the full integration guide and only shows PaymentIntent. The April SetupIntent branch at raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:873-877,1028-1038,1120-1126,1242-1326 and raw/stripe-payments-mobile-finalize-payments-on-the-server-2026-11-07.md:7-21 make that branch central. Put the save-without-charge SetupIntent branch, relevant customer identity, and later distinct PaymentIntent in the summary. Locator-only retrieval from a 6106-line raw does not repair the PaymentIntent-only overview.

wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md:13-38 uses iOS-specific confirmationToken.stripeId as the entire cross-platform client flow and assigns confirm control to Stripe on the default sheet. Distinguish the user's default in-sheet Pay or Set up trigger from app-controlled FlowController/React Native custom confirmation triggers. In both, the server confirms the Stripe Intent and the client uses its returned secret for next actions. Android and React Native examples use confirmationToken.id. See raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:219-225,285-315,1877-1883,2162-2171,4431-4437,4472-4481,4536-4542,5362-5368,5467-5473.

wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md:41-54 is an iOS example and should scope literal update() to iOS. Android reconfigures FlowController with configureWithIntentConfiguration(), avoids presentPaymentOptions()/confirm() while updating and retries a failed update. The React Native variant describes customFlow and confirmPaymentSheetPayment rather than the native iOS update API. See raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:285-306,2162-2205,2369-2407,4472-4542.

wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md:103-104 presents OXXO as an example enabled by the delayed-payment opt-in. In the old iOS and React Native examples, it is explicitly unsupported as of capture, and the flag admits display of eligible supported methods only. Checkout UI completion can be returned while payment remains pending. Add the server webhook boundary, with payment_intent.succeeded for successful fulfillment decisions and processing/failure handled separately. See raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:425-437,556-569,2562-2574,2715-2727,4672-4684,4824-4840.

wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md:72-97 shows the Customers v1 saved-card CustomerSession sample. Scope it to Customers v1 and distinguish customer_account for customer-configured Accounts v2, mobile_payment_element for PaymentSheet, and the CustomerSession client secret from the Intent client secret. Customer association and enabling the save checkbox are distinct prerequisites for optional saved cards, and display requires consent for that future use. See raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:472-554,1030-1038,1267-1313,1324-1332 and wiki/concepts/stripe-saved-payment-methods.md:19-27,78-85.

wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md:68 states the recurring Apple Pay example as a blanket instruction. Old native iOS raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:614-655 requires paymentSummaryItems information for recurring payments, with optional merchant tokens via recurringPaymentRequest or automaticReloadPaymentRequest and iOS-version guards in the example. Order tracking at wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md:70 needs the April iOS 16+ qualification at raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:665-691. React Native's Apple Pay shape differs at raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:4899-4952.

Root route wiki/index.md:5-11 -> stripe-index and wiki/stripe-index.md:103-109,775-779 -> wiki/concepts/stripe-inapp-payments.md:12-38,90-97. Its reciprocal bullet at line 95 should qualify platform-specific update and capture dates. The native PaymentSheet return scheme at raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:96-98,4271-4282 is distinct from the iOS app-to-web Universal Link routes described at wiki/concepts/stripe-inapp-payments.md:83-84,106-110. The concept's broad automatic-compliance claim at line 67 conflicts with the April guide's merchant responsibility and purpose-specific redisplay consent at raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:1328-1330,3803-3805,5605-5607.
historical_claims_to_preserve: 2026-04-22 six-variant guide and provenance at raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:1-6106. Keep platform-specific initialization and supported package examples dated. Keep supported-method and delayed-display qualifications, platform wallet/camera/return-URL constraints, and example versus current SDK boundaries. The new index is additional provenance.

April payment mechanics raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:219-225,341-437 and setup mechanics raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:1028-1038,1120-1126,1242-1373,5519-5650 distinguish ConfirmationToken, Intent client secret, customer-configured Account/Customer, SetupIntent setup and later off-session PaymentIntent with possible authentication errors. Server owns price and confirmation, client owns SDK presentation/next actions. Keep wallet, successful setup, browser return, card verification and payment outcome separate.

April opt-in and event limitations raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:425-437,556-569,2715-2727,4672-4684,4824-4840. Test-card and bank flows in raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:439-466,2576-2603,4686-4713 are scenarios, not timing or success guarantees.
conflicts: wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md:115-117 and April raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:29-80,892-944 describe CocoaPods as an iOS install/update option. The separately read October exact-SHA migration at raw/github/stripe/stripe-ios/supplements/2026-10-29-2f45476-65a4022e/files/MIGRATING-COCOAPODS.md:1-5,23-43 and its reviewed companion wiki/sources/stripe/github/source-github-stripe-ios.md:721-730 establish 26.15.0 as the last native CocoaPods release, with later fixes/features via SPM or XCFrameworks, and direct React Native to its SPM migration. The historical paths remain dated, with reciprocal version qualification between the mobile source and SDK source. No version change derives from the November navigation.

April's React Native deferred-confirmation setup variant says PaymentSheet with SetupIntent supports cards and PayPal (raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:5174-5180), whereas the separate mobile setup guide's endpoint section lists cards, Bancontact, iDEAL, Link, SEPA Debit, Sofort and US bank accounts only (raw/stripe-inapp-set-up-future-payments-2025.md:110-120 and wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-set-up-future-payments.md:13-41). Keep both attributed to their specific variant/UI/setup route and add reciprocal scope if surfaced. The fragment does not support a unified current country/account/SDK method matrix.

The current source's delayed-payment examples overstate OXXO availability and omit the completed-versus-paid distinction (wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md:99-109 compared with raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:425-437,556-569,4824-4840). The adjacent concept's automatic global compliance sentence (wiki/concepts/stripe-inapp-payments.md:67) conflicts with the dated merchant-responsibility and use-specific consent warnings (raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:1328-1330,3803-3805,5605-5607).
unresolved_questions: The six linked November variant bodies are outside the pinned capture. Their current SDK requirements, payment method availability and support, and changes relative to April remain undetermined.

The captured sources do not resolve the reason for different React Native SetupIntent support lists. Keep the statements attributed while SDK/API version, account eligibility and payment-method support across the two routes remain undetermined.

The historical React Native CustomerSession examples put mobile_payment_element at the top level (raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:4747-4760,4791-4804,5755-5768,5799-5812), whereas the iOS/Android examples nest it under components (raw/stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server-2025.md:481-496,2620-2635). The pinned captures do not reconcile the sample discrepancy. Retain it as an example difference without assigning a universal or current API request shape.

source_assessments.reason: The raw delta only changes navigation. The baseline page needs separate material corrections for the omitted central SetupIntent branch and customer identity, scope of client confirmation APIs and defaults, OXXO and authoritative asynchronous payment status, and dated SDK/Apple Pay qualifications. The November capture cannot update those historical mechanics.

answers.Q1: The November 7, 2026 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobile/finalize-payments-on-the-server says to display the Mobile Payment Element before creating the PaymentIntent or SetupIntent and to confirm the corresponding Intent from the server. The index at new raw lines 5-21 gives separate payment and payment-method setup routes for iOS, Android and React Native, with prerequisites and SDK mechanics delegated to the linked variants. The April 22 capture documents a Stripe server API endpoint and enabled methods, client SDK and IntentConfiguration, a ConfirmationToken ID from the client, trusted server amount and currency for PaymentIntent, the server create-and-confirm call, and the Intent client secret for client next actions (old raw lines 14-94, 219-225 and 341-423). The SetupIntent branch attaches the method to a customer-configured Accounts v2 Account or Customers v1 Customer for future use without creating a charge. Its server create-and-confirm returns the SetupIntent secret, and a later off-session payment is a separate PaymentIntent (old raw lines 873-877, 1028-1038 and 1242-1373). The existing source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md preserves the April PaymentIntent walkthrough but omits the corresponding SetupIntent route and the delayed-method webhook distinction. A client completion or return does not establish payment success or funds availability (old raw lines 425-437 and 556-569).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobile/finalize-payments-on-the-server, new raw lines 5-21 keep the original render-before-creation and server-confirmation statement and replace inline platform material with six navigation links. No substantive SDK or API change follows. Retain the April 22, 2026 platform and ConfirmationToken instructions, IntentConfiguration matching, payment/setup differences, enabled methods, account identities, wallet and environment limits, and asynchronous outcome qualification as dated authority (old raw lines 219-225, 285-351, 425-437 and 1028-1038). Existing source-stripe-inapp-finalize-payments-server.md needs independently justified corrections: label stripeId and update() as Swift-specific, distinguish default PaymentSheet triggers from app-owned FlowController and React Native custom triggers, add SetupIntent without charge and separate later PaymentIntent, and scope allowsDelayedPaymentMethods to supported methods. The historical iOS and React Native examples explicitly exclude OXXO and a completed client UI can coexist with server-side processing (old raw lines 556-569, 2162-2171, 4536-4542 and 4824-4840). Retain the April CocoaPods instructions as history and link the reciprocal October stripe-ios 26.15.1 migration qualification, which identifies 26.15.0 as the last CocoaPods release. Keep the dated React Native setup list at old raw lines 5174-5180 scoped alongside the separate setup guide's different list, and keep the mobile concept's consent and native app-return qualifications distinct from compliance guarantees and app-to-web Universal Links.
